In this study, we report the detection of cold ($\leq$ 15 K) CH$_3$OH gas towards two dense cores, which are located $\sim$ 1.2 pc offset from the super star cluster (SSC) candidate (H72.97-69.39) in the N79 region of the LMC.
The possible origins of cold CH$_3$OH gas in these dense cores are discussed, along with a possible explanation for the non-detection of CH$_3$OH in the SSC candidate.
